senses.en: the feeling or mood of a place or situation
the mixture of gases surrounding a planet

ex.en: Soft lighting gave the little restaurant a relaxed atmosphere.
ex.zh: 柔和的灯光为这家小餐馆营造了轻松的氛围。

ex.en: A supportive classroom atmosphere encourages students to ask questions and participate more actively in discussions.
ex.zh: 相互支持的课堂氛围鼓励学生提问，并更加积极地参与讨论。

tip: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。

senses.en: Join or fasten something to something else
Consider something to have a particular value or importance

ex.en: Attach the little bell to your bicycle's handlebars.
ex.zh: 把这个小铃铛装在自行车的车把上。

ex.en: Many employers attach greater importance to practical experience than to academic qualifications when recruiting new staff.
ex.zh: 许多雇主招聘新员工时，更看重实际经验而非学历。

col: attach something to something｜把某物固定到某物上
tip: 常用attach A to B；邮件附件用attachment。

senses.en: An effort to do something, especially something difficult.
To try to do something, especially something difficult.

ex.en: My first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
ex.zh: 我第一次尝试烤面包，结果出乎意料地成功。

ex.en: Many cities are attempting to reduce air pollution by improving public transport and expanding cycling networks.
ex.zh: 许多城市正通过改善公共交通和扩展自行车道网络来尝试减少空气污染。

col: attempt to do something｜尝试做某事
in an attempt to｜为了尝试
tip: 动词后接to do；名词常用an attempt at doing。

senses.en: A person who writes books, articles, or other written works.
To write a book, report, or other written work.

ex.en: The author answered questions about her new adventure novel.
ex.zh: 这位作者回答了有关她新出版的冒险小说的问题。

ex.en: An author can challenge social attitudes by presenting familiar problems through the experiences of unfamiliar characters.
ex.zh: 作者可以借助陌生人物的经历呈现熟悉的问题，从而挑战社会观念。

col: the author of a novel｜一部小说的作者
tip: “……的作者”用the author of；也可作动词。

senses.en: the power or right to make decisions and enforce rules
an official body responsible for a particular area or service
a person with extensive knowledge of a particular subject

ex.en: Only the manager has authority to approve this refund.
ex.zh: 只有经理有权批准这笔退款。

ex.en: Local authorities should consult residents before introducing policies that significantly affect access to public services.
ex.zh: 地方当局在推出显著影响公共服务获取的政策前，应征求居民意见。

col: have authority to do something｜有权做某事
an authority on｜某方面的权威
tip: 表权力通常不可数；the authorities常指当局。

senses.zh: 知道；发觉；有……意识的（；意识到；知道

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a place or counter where drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, are served
a long narrow piece of solid material
to officially prevent someone from entering or doing something

ex.en: We ordered fresh orange juice at the hotel bar.
ex.zh: 我们在酒店的酒吧点了鲜榨橙汁。

ex.en: Sports centres should not bar residents from using essential facilities simply because they cannot afford membership fees.
ex.zh: 体育中心不应仅因居民付不起会员费，就禁止他们使用基本设施。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一条巧克力
bar someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事
tip: 表禁止用bar sb from doing；过去式barred。

senses.en: The main facts or ideas supporting something.
The arrangement or frequency according to which something happens.

ex.en: These fresh vegetables form the basis of our soup.
ex.zh: 这些新鲜蔬菜是我们这锅汤的主要食材。

ex.en: Reliable evidence should provide the basis for government decisions about public health and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 可靠的证据应成为政府作出公共卫生和环境保护决策的依据。

col: form the basis of｜构成……的基础
tip: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。

senses.en: A device that stores energy and supplies electricity.
A large set of similar things, especially tests or questions.

ex.en: The torch needs a new battery before our trip.
ex.zh: 出发旅行前，这只手电筒需要换一节新电池。

ex.en: Improved battery technology could make electric vehicles more affordable and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 电池技术的进步可以降低电动汽车的价格，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。

col: a battery of tests｜一系列测试
tip: 复数为batteries；a battery of可指一系列测试。

senses.en: A fight between armed forces.
A difficult struggle to achieve something or overcome a problem.
To struggle hard against someone or something.

ex.en: The museum displays armour from a famous battle.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了某场著名战役中使用的盔甲。

ex.en: The battle against air pollution requires coordinated action from governments, businesses, and individuals across urban areas.
ex.zh: 对抗空气污染需要城市各地的政府、企业和个人协调行动。

col: battle against pollution｜与污染作斗争
battle for survival｜为生存而斗争
tip: battle可指具体战斗，也常比喻与疾病或困难抗争。

senses.en: The quality of being pleasing to see, hear, or experience.
A particularly useful or attractive feature of something.

ex.en: We stopped to admire the beauty of the lake.
ex.zh: 我们停下来欣赏湖泊的美景。

ex.en: Protecting the natural beauty of coastal areas can support tourism while preserving valuable habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 保护沿海地区的自然美景既能促进旅游业，也能保全珍贵的野生动物栖息地。

col: the beauty of something｜某事物的妙处
tip: 表示“美”通常不可数；the beauty of也指妙处。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a living creature, especially a person
existence or the essential nature of a person or thing

ex.en: Every living being in this pond needs clean water.
ex.zh: 这个池塘里的每一个生物都需要干净的水。

ex.en: Respect for every human being should guide the development of public services and social welfare policies.
ex.zh: 对每个人的尊重都应成为公共服务和社会福利政策制定的指导原则。

tip: 指生物时可数；表示“存在”时通常不可数。

senses.en: Confidence that something is true or someone is capable.
An idea accepted as true, especially about life or religion.

ex.en: Her belief in me helped me try again.
ex.zh: 她对我的信心让我愿意再试一次。

ex.en: The belief that education improves social mobility influences government spending priorities in many countries.
ex.zh: 教育能促进社会流动的这一信念影响着许多国家的政府支出重点。

col: belief in someone｜对某人的信任
a widely held belief｜普遍持有的看法
contrary to popular belief｜与普遍看法相反
tip: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

senses.en: In or to a position directly below something.
Considered too low in status or value for someone.
In or to a lower position.

ex.en: Our cat slept beneath the table during dinner.
ex.zh: 我们吃晚饭时，猫在桌子下面睡觉。

ex.en: Beneath the city's busy streets, an extensive railway network allows residents to travel efficiently.
ex.zh: 在这座城市繁忙的街道下，庞大的铁路网络让居民能够高效出行。

tip: 比under更正式；beneath也可表示有失身份。

senses.en: to risk money on the result of an uncertain event
to say confidently that something is true or will happen
an agreement to risk money on an uncertain result

ex.en: I bet you left your keys in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我敢说你把钥匙落在厨房了。

ex.en: Some investors bet on emerging technologies despite considerable uncertainty about their future commercial success.
ex.zh: 一些投资者押注新兴技术，尽管这些技术未来能否取得商业成功仍很不确定。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常仍是bet；I bet常表确信。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A website or page with regularly added posts.
To write and publish posts on a blog.

ex.en: She writes a blog about growing vegetables at home.
ex.zh: 她写一个介绍在家种菜的博客。

ex.en: A well-researched blog can make scientific information more accessible to readers without specialist knowledge.
ex.zh: 一个研究充分的博客可以让没有专业知识的读者更容易理解科学信息。

col: blog about something｜写关于某事的博客
tip: 一篇博文叫a blog post；blog常指整个博客。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: footwear that covers the foot and part of the leg
the enclosed storage space at the back of a car
to start a computer and load its operating system

ex.en: My boots kept my feet dry in the rain.
ex.zh: 我的靴子让双脚在雨中保持干爽。

ex.en: Protective boots are essential for construction workers because they reduce the risk of serious foot injuries.
ex.zh: 防护靴对建筑工人至关重要，因为它们能降低脚部严重受伤的风险。

col: a pair of boots｜一双靴子
boot up a computer｜启动电脑
tip: 汽车后备箱英式说boot，美式说trunk。

senses.en: Lasting a short time or using few words.
To give someone essential information or instructions.
Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.

ex.en: We took a brief break before finishing the puzzle.
ex.zh: 我们短暂休息了一下，然后完成了拼图。

ex.en: Teachers should brief students on safety procedures before allowing them to conduct experiments independently.
ex.zh: 教师应先向学生介绍安全操作规程，再允许他们独立进行实验。

col: brief someone on｜向某人介绍……的情况
a design brief｜设计任务说明
tip: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A small place serving drinks and light meals.

ex.en: We shared a sandwich at the cafe beside the station.
ex.zh: 我们在车站旁的小餐馆分着吃了一份三明治。

ex.en: A neighbourhood cafe can strengthen community ties by providing a welcoming space for residents to meet.
ex.zh: 社区咖啡馆可以为居民提供友好的聚会空间，从而加强社区联系。

tip: 也写作café；通常提供饮料和简餐。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Having the ability or qualities needed to do something.
Skilled and effective at handling tasks or responsibilities.

ex.en: This little printer is capable of producing excellent colour photos.
ex.zh: 这台小打印机能打印出色彩出众的照片。

ex.en: With appropriate training and support, young employees are capable of taking on substantial responsibilities within an organisation.
ex.zh: 经过适当培训并获得支持，年轻员工有能力在组织内承担重要职责。

col: capable of doing something｜有能力做某事
a capable leader｜能干的领导者
tip: 用capable of doing，不用capable to do。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A public celebration with music, costumes, and street entertainment.
An outdoor event with rides, games, and entertainment.

ex.en: We wore colourful masks and danced at the carnival.
ex.zh: 我们戴着彩色面具，在嘉年华上跳舞。

ex.en: An annual carnival can strengthen community ties while attracting visitors who support local shops and restaurants.
ex.zh: 一年一度的嘉年华可以加强社区联系，同时吸引游客光顾当地商店和餐馆。

tip: 美式英语中也可指有游戏和游乐设施的游乐会。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Farm animals kept for their milk or meat.

ex.en: The cattle gathered under a tree during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中，牛群聚集在一棵树下。

ex.en: Raising cattle requires substantial land and water, which can place pressure on local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 养牛需要大量土地和水，这可能给当地生态系统带来压力。

tip: cattle是复数集合名词，用are；单头牛不用a cattle。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 主席；董事长；会议主持人
senses.en: a person, usually a man, who leads a meeting or organisation

ex.en: The chairman welcomed everyone and opened the meeting.
ex.zh: 主席欢迎大家到场，并宣布会议开始。

ex.en: The chairman of the committee urged members to consider how the proposed policy would affect rural communities.
ex.zh: 委员会主席敦促成员考虑拟议政策会对农村社区产生怎样的影响。

tip: 性别中性的表达可用chair或chairperson。

senses.en: Ask someone to pay a particular amount for something.
An amount of money requested for goods or services.
Put electrical energy into a battery or device.

ex.en: They charge extra if you want breakfast in your room.
ex.zh: 如果你想在房间里吃早餐，他们会额外收费。

ex.en: Museums that charge admission fees should offer discounts to ensure that students can still access cultural resources.
ex.zh: 收取门票的博物馆应提供优惠，以确保学生仍能享用文化资源。

tip: 向某人收取某项费用：charge someone for something。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a building where Christians gather to worship
Christian religious worship attended as a service
an organized group of Christians sharing beliefs and practices

ex.en: The old church has beautiful windows and a stone tower.
ex.zh: 这座古老的教堂有漂亮的窗户和一座石塔。

ex.en: Preserving a historic church can protect local heritage while providing opportunities for education and tourism.
ex.zh: 保护历史悠久的教堂既能保护当地文化遗产，也能为教育和旅游创造机会。

tip: go to church指做礼拜；go to the church指去教堂。

senses.en: to say something is true, often without providing proof
to ask for or take something you believe is yours
a statement of truth or a request for something owed

ex.en: He claims he can fix my bike by lunchtime.
ex.zh: 他声称能在午饭前修好我的自行车。

ex.en: Some researchers claim that access to green spaces can improve mental health and strengthen community relationships.
ex.zh: 一些研究人员认为，能够使用绿地有助于改善心理健康并加强社区联系。

col: make a claim｜提出说法或索赔要求
tip: claim强调某人的说法，不代表已得到证实。

senses.en: To strike your hands together, often to show approval.
A sudden loud sound, especially from hands striking together.

ex.en: Everyone clapped when the children finished their song.
ex.zh: 孩子们唱完歌时，大家都鼓起掌来。

ex.en: Audiences often clap after live performances to express appreciation for the skill and effort of the artists.
ex.zh: 现场演出结束后，观众常常鼓掌，以表达对艺术家技艺和付出的赞赏。

col: a clap of thunder｜一声霹雳
tip: 过去式clapped；现在分词clapping，双写p。

senses.en: relating to formal Western music, such as symphonies and operas
relating to ancient Greece or Rome and their culture
based on established theories rather than newer approaches

ex.en: My sister listens to classical music while cooking.
ex.zh: 我姐姐做饭时听古典音乐。

ex.en: Studying classical architecture helps students understand how ancient design principles continue to influence modern public buildings.
ex.zh: 研究古典建筑有助于学生理解古代设计原则如何持续影响现代公共建筑。

tip: 古典音乐用classical；经典作品常用classic。

senses.en: someone whose job involves records, documents, or routine office tasks
someone serving customers in a shop or at a desk

ex.en: The clerk checked my details and handed me a form.
ex.zh: 办事员核对了我的资料，递给我一张表格。

ex.en: Although digital services are expanding, many residents still prefer discussing complex applications with a trained clerk.
ex.zh: 尽管数字服务不断扩展，许多居民仍更愿意向受过培训的办事员咨询复杂的申请事项。

tip: 英式读音中元音为/ɑː/；美式常指店员。

senses.en: A place providing medical advice or treatment without overnight stays.

ex.en: The clinic near our house opens early on weekdays.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的诊所工作日很早就开门。

ex.en: Local clinics can reduce pressure on hospitals by treating common illnesses and providing preventive care.
ex.zh: 当地诊所可以通过治疗常见病和提供预防性保健来减轻医院的压力。

tip: clinic指诊所或门诊部；“临床的”用clinical。

senses.zh: 结尾的；结束的；停业；关闭；倒闭；最后

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Things people wear to cover or protect their bodies.

ex.en: Pack some warm clothing for our weekend camping trip.
ex.zh: 为我们周末的露营之旅带些保暖衣物。

ex.en: The clothing industry can reduce its environmental impact by using recycled materials and designing products that last longer.
ex.zh: 服装行业可以通过使用再生材料和设计更耐穿的产品来减少对环境的影响。

col: an item of clothing｜一件衣物
tip: clothing不可数；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

senses.en: Information that helps you solve a problem or understand something.

ex.en: The muddy footprints gave us a clue about the visitor.
ex.zh: 泥脚印为我们了解那位访客提供了线索。

ex.en: Ancient tools provide valuable clues about how early communities adapted to changes in their natural environment.
ex.zh: 古代工具为研究早期群落如何适应自然环境的变化提供了宝贵线索。

col: not have a clue｜完全不知道
tip: a clue to中的to是介词，后接名词等。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

ex.en: My colleague brought homemade soup to the office today.
ex.zh: 我的同事今天把自制的汤带到了办公室。

ex.en: Sharing knowledge with colleagues can improve workplace efficiency and help new employees develop essential skills.
ex.zh: 与同事分享知识可以提高工作效率，并帮助新员工培养必要技能。

col: a close colleague｜关系密切的同事
tip: colleague指同事，不一定是朋友或同级员工。

senses.en: funny or connected with comedy
a publication telling stories through sequences of pictures
a performer who entertains people by making them laugh

ex.en: His comic dance had everyone laughing at the party.
ex.zh: 他那滑稽的舞蹈逗得聚会上的每个人都笑了。

ex.en: Comic characters can make educational programmes more engaging and help children remember important information.
ex.zh: 滑稽的角色可以让教育节目更有吸引力，帮助儿童记住重要信息。

tip: comic可指喜剧相关；comical侧重滑稽可笑。

senses.en: Related to business or intended to make money.
An advertisement broadcast on television or radio.

ex.en: This street has homes above its commercial premises.
ex.zh: 这条街的商业用房上面是住宅。

ex.en: Commercial development can create jobs, but it should not come at the expense of public green spaces.
ex.zh: 商业开发能够创造就业机会，但不应以牺牲公共绿地为代价。

tip: 作名词指电视或广播广告，不泛指所有广告。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Examining things to see how they are similar or different.

ex.en: A quick comparison helped me choose the cheaper bicycle.
ex.zh: 简单比较一下后，我选中了更便宜的自行车。

ex.en: A comparison of public transport systems reveals significant differences in cost, reliability and environmental impact.
ex.zh: 对公共交通系统的比较揭示了成本、可靠性和环境影响方面的显著差异。

tip: 两者之间的比较用comparison between A and B。

senses.en: To say that something is wrong or unsatisfactory

ex.en: Our neighbours often complain about noise from the traffic.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居经常抱怨交通噪声。

ex.en: Residents may complain to local authorities when construction work repeatedly disrupts their sleep and daily activities.
ex.zh: 当施工反复影响睡眠和日常活动时，居民可能会向地方当局投诉。

col: complain to the manager｜向经理投诉
tip: 向某人投诉某事：complain to sb about sth。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The parts or substances that something consists of
A piece of writing or music
The activity of creating music or written work

ex.en: We tested the composition of soil in our garden.
ex.zh: 我们检测了自家花园土壤的成分。

ex.en: Changes in the composition of household waste can reveal how consumer habits develop over time.
ex.zh: 生活垃圾构成的变化可以反映消费习惯如何随时间演变。

tip: 指构成或创作过程通常不可数；指作品可数。

senses.en: A feeling of worry about something important

senses.zh: 令人担忧的事；关注事项
senses.en: An issue that matters or causes worry
To relate to someone or something, or cause worry

ex.en: Her main concern is getting home before the storm.
ex.zh: 她最担心的是能否在暴风雨前到家。

ex.en: Growing concern about air pollution has encouraged many cities to invest in cleaner public transport systems.
ex.zh: 人们对空气污染日益担忧，促使许多城市投资建设更清洁的公共交通系统。

col: concern about safety｜对安全的担忧
a major concern｜一个主要问题
concern for others｜对他人的关心
tip: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。

senses.en: Worried about someone or something.
Involved in or affected by a particular matter.
Interested in or dealing with a particular subject.

ex.en: I was concerned when you missed the last bus.
ex.zh: 你没赶上末班公交车时，我很担心。

ex.en: Residents are increasingly concerned about air pollution and want local authorities to improve public transport.
ex.zh: 居民越来越担心空气污染，希望地方政府改善公共交通。

col: as far as I am concerned｜就我而言
tip: about常接担忧对象；with常接涉及的主题。

senses.en: to organize and carry out an activity
to allow heat or electricity to pass through
the way a person behaves, especially towards others

ex.en: Our teacher conducted a quick survey about favourite snacks.
ex.zh: 老师就大家最喜欢的零食做了一次简短调查。

ex.en: Researchers should conduct thorough trials before recommending new treatments for widespread use in public hospitals.
ex.zh: 研究人员在建议公立医院广泛采用新疗法之前，应开展充分的试验。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒndʌkt/。

senses.en: Someone who directs an orchestra or choir
A material that allows heat or electricity to pass through
Someone who checks or sells tickets on public transport

ex.en: The conductor raised her arms, and the orchestra fell silent.
ex.zh: 指挥举起双臂，管弦乐队随即安静下来。

ex.en: Copper is an effective conductor of electricity, making it a common material in household wiring.
ex.zh: 铜是良好的电导体，因此常被用于家庭电路布线。

col: an orchestra conductor｜管弦乐队指挥
a good conductor of heat｜热的良导体
tip: 导体常搭配of heat或of electricity。

senses.en: a formal meeting to discuss a particular subject

ex.en: Our hotel is hosting a conference for local teachers.
ex.zh: 我们酒店正在举办一场面向当地教师的研讨会。

ex.en: At the international conference, researchers discussed how cities could reduce air pollution without limiting economic growth.
ex.zh: 在国际会议上，研究人员讨论了城市如何在不限制经济增长的情况下减少空气污染。

tip: 指正式会议；参加会议用attend a conference。

senses.en: To establish that something is true or correct.
To make an arrangement certain or give it official approval.

ex.en: Please call the hotel to confirm our booking today.
ex.zh: 请今天给酒店打电话，确认我们的预订。

ex.en: Further research is needed to confirm whether smaller classes consistently improve learning outcomes in primary schools.
ex.zh: 还需要进一步研究，以证实小学小班教学是否能持续改善学习效果。

tip: 可接名词或that从句；不要用confirm to do。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Take control of a country or place by force.
Successfully deal with a fear, difficulty, or challenge.

ex.en: She conquered her fear and climbed onto the diving board.
ex.zh: 她克服了恐惧，爬上了跳板。

ex.en: Throughout history, powerful states have sought to conquer neighbouring territories to gain resources and expand their influence.
ex.zh: 纵观历史，强大的国家一直试图征服邻近领土，以获取资源并扩大影响力。

col: conquer a territory｜征服一片领土
conquer a mountain｜征服一座高山
tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语：conquer a fear。

senses.en: the process of building something, especially roads or buildings
something made by joining parts together
the way words are arranged to form a phrase or sentence

ex.en: Construction of the new bridge started early this morning.
ex.zh: 新桥的建设今天一早开始了。

ex.en: The construction of energy-efficient housing can reduce household bills and limit the environmental impact of urban growth.
ex.zh: 建设节能住宅可以降低家庭账单支出，并减少城市扩张对环境的影响。

tip: 表示建造过程时不可数；under construction指在建。

senses.en: an office representing a country and helping its citizens abroad

ex.en: She contacted the consulate after losing her passport abroad.
ex.zh: 她在国外丢失护照后联系了领事馆。

ex.en: A consulate can provide essential assistance to citizens who encounter legal or administrative difficulties while travelling abroad.
ex.zh: 公民在国外旅行期间遇到法律或行政方面的困难时，领事馆可以提供必要的协助。

tip: consulate是领事馆；embassy是大使馆，职能不同。

senses.en: to have something inside or as a part
to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger

ex.en: This small box contains all my sewing supplies.
ex.zh: 这个小盒子里装着我所有的缝纫用品。

ex.en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。

tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To give money, time, or effort towards a shared purpose
To help cause a particular result
To write material for a publication or website

ex.en: Everyone contributed a dish to our shared evening meal.
ex.zh: 每个人都为我们的聚餐带来了一道菜。

ex.en: Limited access to affordable housing can contribute to social inequality and force workers to accept longer commutes.
ex.zh: 难以获得可负担住房可能加剧社会不平等，并迫使劳动者接受更长的通勤时间。

col: contribute to a discussion｜参与讨论
contribute to economic growth｜促进经济增长
tip: contribute to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: clothes worn to look like a particular character or creature
clothing typical of a particular country, culture, or historical period

ex.en: Lena wore a butterfly costume in the school play.
ex.zh: 莉娜在学校话剧里穿了一套蝴蝶戏服。

ex.en: Traditional costume can express cultural identity and help younger generations understand the history of their communities.
ex.zh: 传统服饰能够表达文化认同，并帮助年轻一代理解自己社区的历史。

tip: 指特定角色或文化的服装，不泛指日常衣服。

senses.en: An administrative area within a country or state.

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet village in this county.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母住在这个郡里一个安静的村庄。

ex.en: The county council plans to improve public transport between rural communities and the nearest city.
ex.zh: 郡议会计划改善乡村社区与最近城市之间的公共交通。

tip: 英国的county通常译为“郡”，美国的译为“县”。

senses.en: a place or institution where legal cases are heard
an area for playing sports such as tennis or basketball
to seek something desirable or risk something harmful

ex.en: She will appear in court on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 她将于星期一上午出庭。

ex.en: Local councils should provide public tennis courts so that more residents can exercise regularly.
ex.zh: 地方议会应提供公共网球场，让更多居民能够经常锻炼。

tip: in court指在法庭上；on court指在球场上。

senses.en: an outdoor area partly or completely enclosed by walls or buildings

ex.en: We ate breakfast in the courtyard beside a fountain.
ex.zh: 我们在庭院的喷泉旁吃了早餐。

ex.en: Traditional houses with a central courtyard can provide natural ventilation while offering residents a private outdoor space.
ex.zh: 带有中央庭院的传统住宅既能自然通风，又能为住户提供私密的户外空间。

tip: 强调由建筑或墙围合的露天空间，不等同于花园。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a living being, especially an animal
an imaginary being with unusual physical features

ex.en: A tiny creature crawled out from under the leaf.
ex.zh: 一只小生物从叶子底下爬了出来。

ex.en: Even the smallest marine creature can play an important role in maintaining a healthy ocean ecosystem.
ex.zh: 即使是最小的海洋生物，也能在维持健康的海洋生态系统方面发挥重要作用。

tip: creature常指动物，也可指想象中的生物。

senses.en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses
the amount of a plant harvested at one time
to remove outer parts of an image or cut hair short

ex.en: The farmer checked his wheat crop after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后，农民查看了自己的小麦。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may reduce crop yields, threatening food security in regions that already experience water shortages.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能导致农作物减产，威胁本就缺水地区的粮食安全。

tip: crop既指庄稼也指收成；动词可指裁剪照片。

senses.en: The money used in a particular country.
The state of being widely accepted or used.

ex.en: We exchanged our money for local currency at the airport.
ex.zh: 我们在机场把钱兑换成了当地货币。

ex.en: A weaker currency can attract international tourists by making accommodation and other services more affordable.
ex.zh: 货币贬值可以降低住宿和其他服务的价格，从而吸引国际游客。

tip: 货币种类可数；泛指货币通常不可数。

senses.en: happening, existing, or being used now
a continuous movement of water, air, or electricity

ex.en: My current flat is much closer to work.
ex.zh: 我现在住的公寓离上班的地方近多了。

ex.en: Current policies may need revision as cities face increasing pressure on housing and transport.
ex.zh: 随着城市住房和交通压力不断增加，现行政策可能需要调整。

tip: 形容词指当前的；名词可指水流或电流。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A barrier across a river that holds back water.
To block a river or stream with a barrier.

ex.en: We watched water rushing through the gates of the dam.
ex.zh: 我们看着水从大坝的闸门中奔涌而出。

ex.en: Building a dam can provide renewable electricity, but it may also disrupt river ecosystems and displace communities.
ex.zh: 修建水坝可以提供可再生电力，但也可能扰乱河流生态系统并迫使居民搬迁。

tip: dam是拦水的坝；reservoir是蓄水的水库。

senses.en: facts or information collected for analysis or computer use

ex.en: My watch collects data about how far I walk.
ex.zh: 我的手表会收集有关我步行距离的数据。

ex.en: Reliable data allows policymakers to assess whether environmental regulations are reducing pollution in urban areas.
ex.zh: 可靠的数据能让政策制定者评估环境法规是否正在减少城市污染。

tip: 日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。

senses.en: An organized collection of information stored and accessed electronically.

ex.en: The library database helped me find a gardening book.
ex.zh: 图书馆的数据库帮我找到了一本园艺书。

ex.en: Hospitals need secure databases to protect patient records while allowing doctors to access essential information.
ex.zh: 医院需要安全的数据库来保护病历，同时让医生能够获取必要信息。

tip: 可数名词；在数据库中通常用 in a database。

senses.en: a period of ten years

ex.en: They have lived on this street for a decade.
ex.zh: 他们在这条街上已经住了十年。

ex.en: Over the past decade, digital technology has significantly changed how people access education and healthcare.
ex.zh: 过去十年间，数字技术显著改变了人们获取教育和医疗服务的方式。

col: over the past decade｜在过去十年间
tip: a decade是十年；decades常泛指数十年。

senses.en: Action taken to protect someone or something from attack or harm.
An argument or explanation supporting someone accused or criticized.
Players or actions that stop opponents from scoring in sport.

ex.en: The thick walls provided a strong defence against attackers.
ex.zh: 厚实的城墙为抵御进攻者提供了坚固的屏障。

ex.en: Restoring coastal wetlands offers a natural defence against flooding while creating valuable habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 恢复沿海湿地既能形成防洪的天然屏障，也能为野生动物创造宝贵的栖息地。

tip: 英式拼写 defence；美式拼写 defense。

senses.en: To state exactly what a word or idea means.
To establish the limits, duties, or nature of something clearly.
To be the quality that makes someone or something distinctive.

ex.en: Can you define this word without using a dictionary?
ex.zh: 你能不用词典解释这个词的含义吗？

ex.en: Governments should clearly define their environmental objectives before introducing policies that affect businesses and local communities.
ex.zh: 政府在推行影响企业和当地社区的政策前，应明确界定其环境目标。

col: define a term｜给术语下定义
tip: define A as B表示“将A定义为B”。

senses.en: certainly, with no doubt about something

ex.en: I will definitely bring an umbrella after yesterday's rain.
ex.zh: 昨天下过雨后，我今天肯定会带伞。

ex.en: Improved insulation will definitely reduce heat loss, although total energy savings depend on household behaviour.
ex.zh: 改善隔热性能肯定能减少热量流失，不过总节能量取决于住户的行为。

tip: 拼写是definitely；不要与defiantly混淆。

senses.en: a division of an organisation responsible for a particular subject
an area of a shop selling a particular type of product

ex.en: Please ask our sales department about the delivery date.
ex.zh: 请向我们的销售部门询问送货日期。

ex.en: Each university department should review its courses regularly to ensure they reflect developments in the relevant field.
ex.zh: 大学各系应定期审查课程，确保课程反映相关领域的发展。

tip: 大学的系可用department；学院通常用faculty或school。

senses.en: Someone related to a person who lived in an earlier generation.
Something developed from an earlier form of something similar.

ex.en: Her descendants still live in the old family farmhouse.
ex.zh: 她的后代仍住在家族的老农舍里。

ex.en: Preserving traditional crafts allows descendants of local communities to maintain meaningful connections with their cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 保护传统工艺能让当地社区的后代与自身文化遗产保持有意义的联系。

tip: descendant是后代；ancestor是祖先。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The feeling that there is no hope.
To lose all hope that things will improve.

ex.en: He felt deep despair when his final application was rejected.
ex.zh: 最后一份申请被拒后，他感到深深的绝望。

ex.en: Long periods of unemployment can lead to despair, highlighting the importance of accessible career advice and emotional support.
ex.zh: 长期失业可能让人陷入绝望，这凸显了提供便利的职业咨询和情感支持的重要性。

col: despair of doing something｜对做成某事不抱希望
tip: 名词通常不可数；动词常接of，不接直接宾语。

senses.en: To discover or establish something through examination.
To control or strongly influence what happens.
To make a firm decision to do something.

ex.en: The mechanic determined why my bicycle brakes were sticking.
ex.zh: 修车师傅查明了我的自行车刹车卡住的原因。

ex.en: Researchers must determine whether smaller classes improve learning outcomes before governments invest heavily in additional teaching staff.
ex.zh: 在政府投入大量资金增聘教师之前，研究人员必须确定小班教学是否能改善学习成果。

tip: determine whether 意为查明是否；后接从句。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a simple drawing showing how something works or is arranged
to explain or represent something using a simple drawing

ex.en: The diagram shows how to put the shelves together.
ex.zh: 这张示意图展示了如何组装架子。

ex.en: A clear diagram can help students understand complex biological processes more effectively than a lengthy explanation.
ex.zh: 一张清晰的示意图能比冗长的讲解更有效地帮助学生理解复杂的生物过程。

col: a labelled diagram｜带标注的示意图
tip: 侧重结构或原理的图解，不等同于数据图表。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a reduction in the usual price
to sell something at a reduced price
to consider something unlikely or less important

ex.en: The shop offers a discount on winter coats.
ex.zh: 这家店的冬季外套有折扣。

ex.en: Public transport discounts can encourage more commuters to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 公共交通票价优惠能鼓励更多通勤者不开车出门。

col: discount the possibility｜不考虑这种可能性
tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词通常读/dɪsˈkaʊnt/。

senses.en: To change appearance or hide something's true nature.
Something worn or done to prevent recognition.

ex.en: Nadia disguised herself with a wig and oversized glasses.
ex.zh: 娜迪娅戴上假发和超大眼镜，把自己乔装起来。

ex.en: Attractive packaging can disguise poor product quality, making it harder for consumers to make informed choices.
ex.zh: 精美包装可能掩盖产品质量问题，使消费者更难作出明智选择。

col: disguise yourself as｜把自己装扮成
disguise the fact that｜掩盖……的事实
a blessing in disguise｜因祸得福的事
tip: disguise oneself as后接所扮角色。

senses.en: An area defined by its features or official boundaries.

ex.en: We found a small bakery in the old market district.
ex.zh: 我们在老市场区找到了一家小面包店。

ex.en: Improving public transport in suburban districts can reduce car dependence and widen access to employment.
ex.zh: 改善郊区的公共交通可以减少对汽车的依赖，并增加就业机会。

tip: 可指行政划分，也可指具有特定功能的城区。

senses.en: Including many different kinds of people or things.

ex.en: Our garden attracts a diverse range of colourful birds.
ex.zh: 我们家的花园吸引了各种色彩鲜艳的鸟儿。

ex.en: A culturally diverse workforce can bring fresh perspectives and improve an organisation's ability to solve problems.
ex.zh: 文化背景多元的员工队伍可以带来新视角，提高组织解决问题的能力。

tip: diverse强调种类多或差异大，常修饰群体或范围。

senses.en: The presence of many different types of people or things.

ex.en: Our garden attracts a surprising diversity of colourful birds.
ex.zh: 我们的花园吸引了种类多得惊人的彩色鸟儿。

ex.en: Cultural diversity can enrich urban life by introducing residents to different traditions, languages, and perspectives.
ex.zh: 文化多样性能让居民接触不同的传统、语言和观点，从而丰富城市生活。

tip: 通常为不可数名词；a diversity of表示多种多样的。

senses.zh: 两架航天器）对接：（使）；进港；码头；船坞

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a paper or digital record containing information
record information about something in writing, photographs, or other forms

ex.en: Please save the document before you close your laptop.
ex.zh: 合上笔记本电脑之前，请保存文档。

ex.en: Researchers should document changes in local wildlife to assess the environmental impact of urban development.
ex.zh: 研究人员应记录当地野生生物的变化，以评估城市开发对环境的影响。

tip: 动词末尾读/ment/，名词末尾读/mənt/。

senses.en: a small round mark
to appear in scattered places across an area
the spoken name for a full stop in online addresses

ex.en: Her yellow umbrella has a pattern of blue dots.
ex.zh: 她的黄色雨伞上有蓝色圆点图案。

ex.en: Small villages dot the coastline, attracting visitors who prefer quieter alternatives to crowded seaside resorts.
ex.zh: 小村庄散布在海岸线上，吸引了那些偏爱宁静而非拥挤海滨度假区的游客。

tip: on the dot表示准时，常接在具体时刻之后。

senses.en: On or towards a lower floor of a building
Located on a lower floor of a building

ex.en: I went downstairs when I smelled fresh bread.
ex.zh: 闻到新鲜面包的香味后，我下了楼。

ex.en: Providing a downstairs bedroom can help older residents remain independent in their own homes.
ex.zh: 在楼下设置卧室可以帮助老年住户在自己家中保持独立生活。

tip: 作副词时直接说go downstairs，不加to。

senses.en: in or towards the central business area of a city
located in the central business area of a city
the central business area of a city

ex.en: We took the bus downtown to buy new shoes.
ex.zh: 我们乘公交车去市中心买新鞋。

ex.en: Improved public transport can encourage more residents to shop downtown rather than drive to suburban shopping centres.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以鼓励更多居民到市中心购物，而不是开车前往郊区购物中心。

tip: 主要用于美式英语；作副词时前面不加to。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Required to be paid or submitted by a particular time.
Expected to happen or arrive at a particular time.
Deserved or appropriate in a particular situation.

ex.en: Our rent is due at the end of the week.
ex.zh: 我们的房租本周末到期应付。

ex.en: When tuition fees are due, some students struggle to cover both educational expenses and basic living costs.
ex.zh: 学费到期应缴时，一些学生难以同时承担教育支出和基本生活费用。

tip: be due to do表示预计做；due to＋名词表示由于。

senses.en: very interested and excited about doing or having something

ex.en: The children were eager to open their presents.
ex.zh: 孩子们迫不及待地想拆开礼物。

ex.en: Many graduates are eager to gain practical experience before committing to a particular career path.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生渴望先积累实践经验，再决定具体的职业道路。

tip: 常用eager to do或eager for＋名词。

senses.en: To receive money in return for work.
To gain something deserved through your actions or qualities.

ex.en: She earns extra money by walking dogs after school.
ex.zh: 她放学后帮人遛狗，赚些零花钱。

ex.en: Companies can earn public trust by reporting their environmental impact honestly and taking responsibility for their mistakes.
ex.zh: 企业可以通过如实报告环境影响并为自身错误负责来赢得公众信任。

tip: earn强调劳动或表现所得；win多指比赛获胜。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: relating to Egypt, its people, or its culture
a person from Egypt

ex.en: We admired Egyptian pottery at the museum yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们昨天在博物馆欣赏了埃及陶器。

ex.en: Ancient Egyptian irrigation systems demonstrate how communities adapted farming practices to seasonal changes in river levels.
ex.zh: 古埃及的灌溉系统展示了当地居民如何调整耕作方式，以适应河流水位的季节性变化。

tip: 首字母须大写；指多名埃及人时用 Egyptians。

senses.en: to choose someone for a position by voting
to choose to do something

ex.en: Our club elected a new captain last night.
ex.zh: 我们俱乐部昨晚选出了一位新队长。

ex.en: Citizens should elect representatives who are willing to address long-term environmental challenges rather than seek immediate popularity.
ex.zh: 公民应当选举愿意应对长期环境挑战的代表，而不是追求眼前人气的人。

col: elect someone to office｜选举某人任职
elect to do something｜选择做某事
tip: elect sb chair 中职务前常不加冠词。

senses.en: a process in which people vote to choose representatives
the act of being chosen for a position by voting

ex.en: Our club is holding an election for its next chair.
ex.zh: 我们俱乐部正在举行选举，选出下一任主席。

ex.en: A fair election requires transparent procedures and equal opportunities for candidates to present their policies.
ex.zh: 公平的选举需要透明的程序，并让候选人有平等机会介绍其政策。

tip: elect强调投票选出；select泛指挑选。

senses.en: An important or basic part of something.
A substance that cannot be chemically divided into simpler substances.
Strong wind, rain, or other difficult weather conditions.

ex.en: Fresh herbs are a key element of this soup.
ex.zh: 新鲜香草是这道汤的关键配料。

ex.en: Public trust is an essential element of any successful policy aimed at improving community health.
ex.zh: 公众信任是任何旨在改善社区健康的政策取得成功的必要因素。

col: exposure to the elements｜暴露于风雨之中
tip: 表示风雨等自然力量时，通常用the elements。

senses.en: in or to another place

ex.en: This café is full, so let's eat elsewhere.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆坐满了，我们去别处吃吧。

ex.en: When local housing becomes unaffordable, young workers often move elsewhere in search of better living conditions.
ex.zh: 当本地住房变得难以负担时，年轻劳动者往往会迁往别处，寻找更好的生活条件。

col: elsewhere in the world｜在世界其他地方
tip: 本身是副词，通常不说in elsewhere或to elsewhere。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To make certain that something happens or is true

ex.en: Please ensure that all windows are closed before leaving.
ex.zh: 离开前请确保所有窗户都已关好。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that affordable public transport is available to residents in both urban and rural areas.
ex.zh: 政府应确保城市和农村居民都能享有价格实惠的公共交通。

tip: ensure接名词或that从句；insure指投保。

senses.en: An opening or place through which people enter.
The act of entering or the right to join.

ex.en: I'll meet you at the entrance after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我在入口处与你碰面。

ex.en: Universities should ensure that entrance requirements recognise different educational backgrounds while maintaining appropriate academic standards.
ex.zh: 大学应确保入学要求兼顾不同教育背景，同时维持适当的学术标准。

tip: 某处的入口用entrance to，不用entrance of。

senses.en: To give someone responsibility for something or someone valuable.

ex.en: I entrusted my neighbour with the spare house key.
ex.zh: 我把家里的备用钥匙托付给了邻居。

ex.en: Parents entrust schools with their children's education and expect teachers to provide a safe learning environment.
ex.zh: 家长把孩子的教育托付给学校，并期待教师提供安全的学习环境。

col: entrust someone with a task｜委托某人执行任务
entrust something to someone｜把某物托付给某人
entrust someone with responsibility｜委以某人重任
tip: entrust人with物；entrust物to人。

senses.en: A flat paper container used for sending a letter.

ex.en: She slipped the birthday card into a blue envelope.
ex.zh: 她把生日贺卡放进了一个蓝色信封。

ex.en: Although digital communication is widespread, official documents are still sometimes delivered in a sealed envelope for privacy.
ex.zh: 尽管数字通信十分普及，官方文件有时仍会装在密封信封里送达，以保护隐私。

col: a padded envelope｜有衬垫的信封
tip: envelope是“信封”；envelop是“包围”的动词。

senses.en: the tools and other items needed for a particular activity

ex.en: Please put the camping equipment back in the garage.
ex.zh: 请把露营装备放回车库。

ex.en: Schools need suitable laboratory equipment to give students practical experience and encourage an interest in science.
ex.zh: 学校需要合适的实验室设备，让学生获得实践经验并培养科学兴趣。

col: a piece of equipment｜一件设备
tip: 不可数；一件设备说a piece of equipment。

senses.en: to get away from confinement or a dangerous situation
to avoid something unpleasant or harmful
the act of getting free from danger or unpleasant conditions

ex.en: Our rabbit escaped through a small gap in the fence.
ex.zh: 我们的兔子从围栏的一处小缝隙逃走了。

ex.en: Accessible parks offer urban residents an escape from crowded streets and opportunities to enjoy nature.
ex.zh: 便利可达的公园让城市居民得以远离拥挤的街道，并有机会亲近自然。

tip: 逃离某处用escape from；免遭某事可直接接名词。

senses.en: to start an organisation, system, or lasting arrangement
to make a position or reputation widely accepted
to discover or prove that something is true

ex.en: Our neighbours established a gardening club last spring.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居去年春天成立了一个园艺俱乐部。

ex.en: Governments should establish clear standards to ensure that new housing is both safe and energy efficient.
ex.zh: 政府应制定明确的标准，确保新建住房既安全又节能。

tip: establish是及物动词，后接机构、制度或事实等。

senses.zh: 具有民族特色的；异国风味的；民族的；种族的

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 节日或重大事件的前夕
senses.en: The day or evening before a special day or event.
The first woman in the biblical account of creation.

ex.en: We cooked a special dinner together on New Year's Eve.
ex.zh: 我们在除夕夜一起做了一顿特别的晚餐。

ex.en: On New Year's Eve, cities often extend public transport services to help large crowds travel home safely.
ex.zh: 在除夕夜，城市往往延长公共交通的运营时间，帮助大批人群安全返家。

tip: 普通名词eve通常小写；节日名称中大写，Eve也指夏娃。

senses.en: in the end, especially after a long time or difficulty

ex.en: After searching every room, we eventually found the missing keys.
ex.zh: 搜遍每个房间后，我们终于找到了丢失的钥匙。

ex.en: Investment in public transport may initially be expensive, but it can eventually reduce congestion and improve urban life.
ex.zh: 公共交通投资起初可能成本高昂，但最终能够缓解拥堵并改善城市生活。

tip: 强调经过时间或困难后的结果，不表示可能。

senses.en: Facts or signs that help establish whether something is true.
To show clearly that something exists or is true.

ex.en: The muddy footprints were evidence that someone had entered.
ex.zh: 泥脚印表明有人进来过。

ex.en: Governments should consider scientific evidence before introducing policies intended to improve public health outcomes.
ex.zh: 政府在推出旨在改善公共健康状况的政策前，应考虑科学证据。

tip: 作名词通常不可数：一项证据用a piece of evidence。

senses.en: morally very bad and deliberately causing harm
serious moral wrongdoing or something that causes great harm

ex.en: In the story, an evil wizard steals everyone's dreams.
ex.zh: 故事里，一个邪恶的巫师偷走了所有人的梦。

ex.en: Literature often explores the conflict between good and evil through characters who face difficult moral choices.
ex.zh: 文学作品常通过面临艰难道德选择的人物，探讨善与恶的冲突。

col: a necessary evil｜不得已接受的坏事
tip: 比bad语气强得多，通常涉及严重的道德恶行。

senses.en: To be real or present in the world.
To stay alive, especially with very limited resources.

ex.en: Do you think creatures like these really exist?
ex.zh: 你觉得这样的生物真的存在吗？

ex.en: Significant differences in access to healthcare still exist between rural communities and major urban centres.
ex.zh: 农村社区与主要城市中心在医疗服务的可及性方面仍存在显著差异。

col: exist in nature｜存在于自然界
exist on limited resources｜靠有限资源维生
tip: 是不及物动词，不用被动语态；“不存在”用does not exist。

senses.en: a door or passage used to leave a place
to leave a place or close a computer program

ex.en: We found the exit at the back of the cinema.
ex.zh: 我们在电影院后部找到了出口。

ex.en: Public buildings must have clearly visible emergency exits so that occupants can leave safely during an evacuation.
ex.zh: 公共建筑必须设有清晰可见的紧急出口，以便楼内人员在疏散时安全离开。

tip: 名词指“出口”，动词指“离开”；不要与 exist 混淆。

senses.en: to send goods to another country for sale
selling goods abroad, or goods sold to another country
to save computer data in a format another program uses

ex.en: My aunt's company exports handmade bowls to several countries.
ex.zh: 我姑姑的公司向多个国家出口手工碗。

ex.en: Countries that export mainly raw materials may be vulnerable to sudden changes in global commodity prices.
ex.zh: 主要出口原材料的国家可能容易受到全球大宗商品价格突变的冲击。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前。

senses.en: How much something happens or how far it reaches.

ex.en: We only discovered the extent of the leak yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们昨天才发现漏水有多严重。

ex.en: The extent to which public transport reduces pollution depends on passenger numbers and energy sources.
ex.zh: 公共交通能在多大程度上减少污染，取决于乘客数量和能源来源。

col: to some extent｜在某种程度上
the full extent of｜……的全部程度或范围
to a large extent｜在很大程度上
tip: 表示“在某种程度上”用to some extent。

senses.en: Located on the outside of something.
Coming from outside a particular organisation, system, or situation.

ex.en: The builders painted the external walls pale yellow.
ex.zh: 建筑工人把外墙刷成了淡黄色。

ex.en: Universities often rely on external funding to conduct research that cannot be supported by tuition fees alone.
ex.zh: 大学经常依赖外部资金，开展仅靠学费无法支持的研究。

col: for external use only｜仅供外用
tip: external与internal相对；药品上指外用的。

senses.en: having no living members left
describing a volcano not expected to erupt again

ex.en: My little cousin asked why dinosaurs became extinct.
ex.zh: 我的小表弟问恐龙为什么灭绝了。

ex.en: Without stronger habitat protection, many endangered species could become extinct within the next few decades.
ex.zh: 如果不加强栖息地保护，许多濒危物种可能在未来几十年内灭绝。

tip: extinct指已灭绝；endangered指濒危，尚未灭绝。

senses.en: the complete disappearance of a species or type of thing

ex.en: These rare birds face extinction if their forest disappears.
ex.zh: 如果这片森林消失，这些珍稀鸟类就会面临灭绝。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential to preventing the extinction of species threatened by intensive farming and urban expansion.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于防止受集约化农业和城市扩张威胁的物种灭绝至关重要。

col: on the brink of extinction｜濒临灭绝
tip: extinct是形容词；extinction是通常不可数的名词。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A place or equipment provided for a particular purpose.
A feature or service that enables a particular activity.
A natural ability to do or learn something easily.

ex.en: The new sports facility has a bright indoor pool.
ex.zh: 这座新体育设施里有一个明亮的室内泳池。

ex.en: Investing in local healthcare facilities can improve access to essential services for people in rural communities.
ex.zh: 投资当地医疗设施可以让农村社区居民更容易获得基本服务。

col: a facility for languages｜语言天赋
tip: 泛指配套设施常用复数facilities。

senses.en: to lose colour or make something lose colour gradually
to become weaker, less clear, or less noticeable over time

ex.en: The curtains have faded after years of bright sunlight.
ex.zh: 窗帘经过多年强烈日晒，已经褪色了。

ex.en: Public interest in environmental campaigns may fade unless organisations provide regular updates and opportunities for participation.
ex.zh: 如果组织不定期提供最新进展和参与机会，公众对环保活动的兴趣可能会逐渐减退。

col: fade in the sun｜在阳光下褪色
fade into the background｜逐渐不再引人注意
tip: 强调逐渐变化；fade away指慢慢减弱或消失。

senses.en: not strong, clear or easy to notice
feeling weak and close to losing consciousness
to suddenly lose consciousness for a short time

ex.en: A faint light shone through the bedroom curtains.
ex.zh: 一丝微弱的光透过卧室窗帘照了进来。

ex.en: Astronomers use powerful telescopes to detect faint objects that cannot be seen with the naked eye.
ex.zh: 天文学家使用高性能望远镜探测肉眼看不见的暗弱天体。

tip: feel faint是快要晕倒；faint作动词才表示昏倒。

senses.en: Strong trust or confidence in someone or something.
Belief in a god, or a particular religious system.

ex.en: I have faith in your ability to fix this.
ex.zh: 我相信你有能力修好这个。

ex.en: Transparent decision-making can strengthen public faith in institutions and encourage greater participation in community affairs.
ex.zh: 透明的决策过程能够增强公众对机构的信任，并鼓励更多人参与社区事务。

col: in good faith｜真诚地；善意地
tip: 表示对某人或某事有信心，用have faith in。

senses.en: not true or based on facts
made to resemble something real or natural
intended to hide someone's real feelings or intentions

ex.en: That rumour about our neighbour is completely FALSE.
ex.zh: 那条关于我们邻居的传闻完全不实。

ex.en: Claims that all online information is reliable are FALSE, so students should learn to evaluate sources critically.
ex.zh: 声称所有网络信息都可靠是错误的，因此学生应学会批判性地评估信息来源。

tip: false指不真实；fake更强调刻意仿冒。通常写作小写。

senses.en: To want something or feel like doing something.
Decorative, elaborate, or expensive rather than plain.
To feel romantically attracted to someone.

ex.en: Do you fancy a walk by the river after lunch?
ex.zh: 午饭后你想去河边散步吗？

ex.en: Some tourists prefer simple local accommodation to fancy hotels because it offers more opportunities for cultural exchange.
ex.zh: 一些游客更喜欢简朴的当地住宿，而非豪华酒店，因为前者提供更多文化交流机会。

col: a fancy restaurant｜一家豪华餐厅
tip: 表示“想做”时用fancy doing，不用fancy to do。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: so interesting that it holds your attention completely

ex.en: The guide told us fascinating stories about the castle.
ex.zh: 导游给我们讲了关于这座城堡的精彩故事。

ex.en: Museum collections offer fascinating insights into how earlier societies adapted to changes in their natural environments.
ex.zh: 博物馆藏品让人们深入了解早期社会如何适应自然环境的变化，令人着迷。

tip: 事物令人着迷用fascinating；人着迷用fascinated。

senses.en: Causing someone's death.
Causing something to fail completely.

ex.en: These wild mushrooms can be fatal if you eat them.
ex.zh: 这些野生蘑菇吃了可能会致命。

ex.en: Lower speed limits near schools can reduce the risk of fatal accidents involving pedestrians and cyclists.
ex.zh: 降低学校附近的限速可以减少涉及行人和骑车人的致命事故风险。

tip: fatal强调致死或导致失败；fateful指影响重大的。

senses.en: A large, special meal with plenty of food.
Something that gives great pleasure to the senses.
To eat and enjoy a large amount of food.

ex.en: We prepared a feast for the whole family.
ex.zh: 我们为全家准备了一顿盛宴。

ex.en: Traditional festivals often include a communal feast that strengthens relationships and preserves local food culture.
ex.zh: 传统节日常有集体宴席，既增进人际关系，也传承当地饮食文化。

col: a feast for the eyes｜视觉盛宴
tip: 动词常用feast on，表示尽情享用某种食物。

senses.en: a noticeable or important part of something
to include or present someone or something prominently
a part of the face, such as the nose

ex.en: My favourite feature of this backpack is its hidden pocket.
ex.zh: 这个背包最让我喜欢的特点是它的隐藏口袋。

ex.en: Public parks are an essential feature of cities that prioritise residents' health and wellbeing.
ex.zh: 在重视居民健康与福祉的城市中，公共公园是一项不可或缺的特色。

tip: 作动词时直接接宾语，不说feature with。

senses.en: Money charged for a service, course, or professional advice.

ex.en: The gym charges a small fee for each class.
ex.zh: 这家健身房每节课收取少量费用。

ex.en: High tuition fees may discourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds from applying to university, even when financial assistance is available.
ex.zh: 高昂的学费可能使家境困难的学生不愿申请大学，即使有经济援助可用。

tip: fee指服务或入场等费用；小费通常用tip。

senses.en: relating to money or how it is managed

ex.en: We asked for financial advice before buying our first home.
ex.zh: 购买第一套住房前，我们咨询了理财建议。

ex.en: Financial support for disadvantaged students can improve access to higher education and reduce long-term inequality.
ex.zh: 为弱势学生提供经济支持可以增加他们接受高等教育的机会，并减少长期存在的不平等。

col: financial stability｜金融稳定；财务稳定
tip: financial侧重金钱与财务；economic侧重经济整体。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: an object that burns or explodes with bright colours outdoors

ex.en: A single firework burst above the lake, scattering golden sparks.
ex.zh: 一枚烟花在湖面上空绽放，洒下金色火花。

ex.en: Public firework displays can attract visitors, although their noise may disturb local residents and wildlife.
ex.zh: 公共焰火表演可以吸引游客，但其噪声可能打扰当地居民和野生动物。

tip: 单枚烟花可数；泛指烟花或焰火表演常用fireworks。

senses.en: able to change to suit different needs or situations
able to bend easily without breaking

ex.en: My flexible schedule lets me collect the children after school.
ex.zh: 我的时间安排很灵活，可以在放学后接孩子。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees balance professional responsibilities with their family commitments.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排能帮助员工兼顾工作职责与家庭责任。

col: flexible working hours｜弹性工作时间
tip: 既可形容安排灵活，也可形容材料易弯曲。

senses.en: To stay on a liquid's surface or move gently through air.
To suggest an idea for others to consider.
A decorated vehicle used in a parade.

ex.en: A yellow leaf floated gently across the garden pond.
ex.zh: 一片黄叶轻轻漂过花园里的池塘。

ex.en: Researchers have floated the idea of using artificial islands to provide additional housing in crowded coastal cities.
ex.zh: 研究人员提出了利用人工岛为拥挤的沿海城市提供更多住房的想法。

col: float an idea｜提出一个想法
tip: float an idea是提出想法供讨论，并非实施。

senses.en: a mass of small bubbles on or in a liquid
a light material containing many tiny air pockets
to produce a mass of small bubbles

ex.en: White foam covered my hands as I washed the dishes.
ex.zh: 洗碗时，白色泡沫盖满了我的双手。

ex.en: Manufacturers often use foam packaging to protect fragile goods, although some types are difficult to recycle.
ex.zh: 制造商常用泡沫包装保护易碎商品，但某些泡沫材料难以回收。

tip: foam作泡沫或泡沫材料时通常不可数。

senses.en: to bend something so one part lies over another
a bend or crease in paper, cloth, or skin
to close because a business cannot continue operating

ex.en: Please fold these towels and put them on the shelf.
ex.zh: 请把这些毛巾叠好，放到架子上。

ex.en: Small businesses may fold when rising rental costs make it impossible to maintain a reasonable profit.
ex.zh: 当租金上涨导致无法维持合理利润时，小企业可能倒闭。

col: fold your arms｜双臂交叉抱在胸前
fold up a chair｜把椅子折起来
fold the laundry｜叠洗好的衣物
tip: fold强调折叠；bend只表示弯曲，不一定叠合。

senses.en: having a particular role or condition in the past
being the first of two people or things just mentioned

ex.en: My former neighbour still visits us every summer.
ex.zh: 我以前的邻居每年夏天仍会来看我们。

ex.en: Former industrial sites can be transformed into public parks, improving urban environments and creating shared spaces.
ex.zh: 昔日的工业用地可以改建为公园，从而改善城市环境并创造共享空间。

col: former industrial site｜昔日工业用地
tip: the former 指两者中的前者，the latter 指后者。

senses.en: A very large amount of money
Luck or the events that shape someone's life

ex.en: That tiny flat near the station costs a fortune.
ex.zh: 车站附近那套小公寓贵得惊人。

ex.en: Some entrepreneurs build a fortune by developing affordable products that meet previously overlooked needs.
ex.zh: 一些创业者通过开发满足以往被忽视需求的平价产品，积累了巨额财富。

tip: 表示大笔财富时用a fortune；表示运气时通常不可数。

senses.zh: 坦率的；直率的；坦白说；坦率地说

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The purpose or job of something or someone.
To work or operate in the intended way.
A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.

ex.en: What is the function of this small red button?
ex.zh: 这个红色小按钮有什么作用？

ex.en: Urban parks serve an important function by providing space for exercise, relaxation, and social interaction.
ex.zh: 城市公园提供运动、休闲和社交的空间，发挥着重要作用。

tip: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

senses.en: money saved or collected for a particular purpose
money available to spend, usually expressed in the plural
to provide money for an activity, organisation, or project

ex.en: We started a small fund to repair the playground.
ex.zh: 我们设立了一笔小额专款，用来修缮游乐场。

ex.en: Governments should fund research into renewable energy to reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve energy security.
ex.zh: 政府应资助可再生能源研究，以减少对化石燃料的依赖并提高能源安全。

tip: 专用基金可说 a fund；泛指可用资金常用 funds。

senses.en: to a greater degree or a more distant place
additional or more advanced
to help something develop or succeed

ex.en: We walked further along the beach before stopping.
ex.zh: 我们沿着海滩又走了一段才停下。

ex.en: Further research is needed to understand how urban green spaces affect residents' mental health.
ex.zh: 还需要进一步研究，才能了解城市绿地如何影响居民的心理健康。

col: further your career｜促进职业发展
tip: further可指程度或距离；farther主要指距离。

senses.en: A room or building where artworks are displayed or sold.
A raised seating area overlooking a hall or theatre.
A collection of images available to view, especially online.

ex.en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring the local gallery.
ex.zh: 一个下雨的下午，我们逛了当地的美术馆。

ex.en: Free entry to a public gallery can make visual art accessible to people from different economic backgrounds.
ex.zh: 公共美术馆免费开放，可以让不同经济背景的人都有机会接触视觉艺术。

col: public gallery｜公共美术馆；旁听席
tip: gallery主要展示艺术品；museum涵盖的展品范围更广。

senses.en: to collect things from different places or sources
to come together or bring people together
to understand something from what you hear or observe

ex.en: We gathered fallen apples in a basket before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前，我们把掉落的苹果收进了篮子。

ex.en: Researchers gather information from local residents to understand how public transport affects access to employment.
ex.zh: 研究人员向当地居民收集信息，以了解公共交通如何影响就业机会的获取。

tip: I gather that...表示“我听说或推断……”。

senses.en: willing to give money, time, or help freely
larger or more plentiful than usual or expected

ex.en: Our generous neighbour shared her fresh vegetables with us.
ex.zh: 我们那位大方的邻居把新鲜蔬菜分给了我们。

ex.en: Generous donations from local businesses can help community centres provide affordable activities for children and older residents.
ex.zh: 当地企业的慷慨捐助可以帮助社区中心为儿童和老年居民提供价格实惠的活动。

col: generous with your time｜不吝惜时间
tip: be generous with sth表示在某方面慷慨。

senses.en: Much larger than usual
An imaginary person of enormous size
A very large company or an exceptionally important person

ex.en: A giant pumpkin filled almost the entire garden cart.
ex.zh: 一个巨大的南瓜几乎占满了整辆园艺推车。

ex.en: Technology giants have considerable influence over how people access information and communicate with one another.
ex.zh: 科技巨头对人们获取信息和相互交流的方式有很大影响。

tip: 作形容词通常放名词前；作名词可指行业巨头。

senses.en: A ball-shaped model of Earth showing its land and oceans.
The Earth, especially when considering all its regions.
An object shaped like a ball.

ex.en: She spun the globe and pointed to a tiny island.
ex.zh: 她转动地球仪，指向一座小岛。

ex.en: Researchers across the globe are sharing climate data to improve predictions of extreme weather events.
ex.zh: 世界各地的研究人员正在共享气候数据，以提高对极端天气事件的预测能力。

tip: a globe常指地球仪；the globe常指整个世界。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: smooth, attractive movement or behaviour
extra time or kindness freely given
make a place or occasion more attractive by being present

ex.en: The dancer moved across the stage with effortless grace.
ex.zh: 那位舞者轻盈优雅地穿过舞台。

ex.en: A short grace period can help households manage unexpected delays in receiving their income.
ex.zh: 短暂的宽限期可以帮助家庭应对收入意外延迟到账的情况。

tip: grace 表优雅通常不可数；grace period 指宽限期。

senses.en: Happening slowly through small changes over time
Rising or falling gently rather than steeply

ex.en: There was a gradual improvement in her sleep.
ex.zh: 她的睡眠逐渐改善了。

ex.en: A gradual transition to renewable energy can help communities adapt without causing sudden job losses.
ex.zh: 逐步转向可再生能源有助于社区适应变化，避免就业岗位骤减。

tip: 强调变化缓慢、分阶段；副词形式为gradually。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Feeling thankful for kindness, help, or something good.

ex.en: I am grateful for your help with the move.
ex.zh: 谢谢你帮我搬家。

ex.en: Many students are grateful for scholarships that allow them to continue their education despite financial difficulties.
ex.zh: 许多学生感谢奖学金让他们即使经济困难也能继续学业。

tip: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。

senses.en: A feeling of thankfulness for help or kindness received.

ex.en: She brought fresh flowers to express her gratitude.
ex.zh: 她带来鲜花表达感激之情。

ex.en: Schools can encourage gratitude by helping students recognise the contributions that others make to their daily lives.
ex.zh: 学校可以帮助学生认识到他人对自己日常生活的贡献，从而培养感恩之心。

col: gratitude to someone｜对某人的感激
gratitude for something｜对某事的感激
a token of gratitude｜一点谢意
tip: 对人感激用to，对某事感激用for；通常不可数。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Advice or a principle explaining how something should be done.

ex.en: These guidelines explain how to store food safely.
ex.zh: 这些指南说明了如何安全储存食物。

ex.en: Clear guidelines on data collection can help researchers protect participants while maintaining the quality of their studies.
ex.zh: 明确的数据收集准则可以帮助研究人员在维持研究质量的同时保护参与者。

tip: 常用复数guidelines；通常指指导而非强制法规。

senses.zh: 秋葵汤（用秋葵英做的浓鸡汤或海鲜汤

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the natural environment where an animal or plant lives

ex.en: This pond provides a perfect habitat for frogs.
ex.zh: 这个池塘为青蛙提供了理想的栖息地。

ex.en: Urban expansion destroys natural habitats, making it harder for native species to find food and shelter.
ex.zh: 城市扩张破坏了自然栖息地，使本地物种更难找到食物和庇护所。

tip: habit 是习惯，habitat 是动植物的栖息地。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the gathering of crops, or the crops gathered
to gather crops when they are ready

ex.en: We celebrated the apple harvest with a homemade pie.
ex.zh: 我们做了一个自制苹果派，庆祝苹果丰收。

ex.en: Unpredictable rainfall can reduce the annual harvest, threatening rural incomes and increasing food prices in cities.
ex.zh: 难以预测的降雨可能减少年度收成，威胁农村收入并推高城市食品价格。

tip: 作名词可指收割活动，也可指收获的作物或产量。

senses.en: The rounded back part of the foot below the ankle.
The raised part beneath the back of a shoe.

ex.en: These new shoes rub against my left heel.
ex.zh: 这双新鞋磨我的左脚后跟。

ex.en: Shoes that support the heel properly may improve comfort for people who spend long hours standing.
ex.zh: 能适当支撑脚后跟的鞋子，可以让长时间站立的人感觉更舒适。

tip: heel是脚后跟或鞋跟；heal意为愈合，二者同音。

senses.en: Relating to herbs or made from them.

ex.en: I usually drink herbal tea before going to bed.
ex.zh: 我通常在睡前喝花草茶。

ex.en: Although herbal remedies are widely used, their safety and effectiveness should be assessed through reliable scientific research.
ex.zh: 尽管草药疗法应用广泛，其安全性和有效性仍应通过可靠的科学研究来评估。

tip: 英式发音读出h，美式通常不读h。

senses.en: a group of large animals living or moving together
to guide animals or people together in a particular direction

ex.en: A herd of cows blocked the narrow country road.
ex.zh: 一群奶牛堵住了狭窄的乡间道路。

ex.en: Protecting migration routes allows herds of wild animals to reach essential sources of food and water.
ex.zh: 保护迁徙路线能让野生动物群到达重要的食物和水源所在地。

tip: 牛、象等成群用herd；羊群、鸟群通常用flock。

senses.en: Traditions, buildings, and values passed down from earlier generations.

ex.en: These old songs are part of our family heritage.
ex.zh: 这些老歌是我们家族传承的一部分。

ex.en: Protecting cultural heritage can strengthen community identity while attracting visitors who support local businesses.
ex.zh: 保护文化遗产能够增强社区认同感，同时吸引游客，支持当地商业。

col: preserve our heritage｜保护我们的遗产
rich heritage｜丰富的历史文化遗产
tip: 多指文化与历史传承；个人继承财产常用inheritance。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To pay someone to do a job.
To pay to use something for a limited time.
An arrangement to use something temporarily in exchange for payment.

ex.en: We hired a van to move our furniture.
ex.zh: 我们租了一辆货车来搬家具。

ex.en: Businesses that hire local workers can strengthen regional economies and reduce the need for long commutes.
ex.zh: 雇用当地员工的企业可以增强区域经济，并减少长途通勤的需要。

tip: 租车英式常用hire，美式常用rent。

senses.zh: 有历史意义的；历史著名的
senses.en: Important in history or likely to be remembered in history.

ex.en: We crossed the historic bridge just before sunset.
ex.zh: 我们在日落前走过了那座历史名桥。

ex.en: Protecting historic buildings helps cities preserve their cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting local businesses.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市保留文化特色，同时吸引游客并支持当地商业。

col: historic agreement｜具有历史意义的协议
tip: historic强调历史意义；historical泛指与历史有关。

senses.en: very unpleasant or bad
causing strong fear or shock

ex.en: A horrible smell came from the forgotten lunch box.
ex.zh: 那个被遗忘的午餐盒散发出难闻的气味。

ex.en: Residents described the horrible conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter enforcement of safety standards.
ex.zh: 居民描述了拥挤住房中的恶劣条件，并呼吁更严格地执行安全标准。

tip: horrible常指很糟糕；horrific多指骇人、惨烈。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To recognize and establish who or what someone or something is.
To discover or establish something through examination.
To feel connected to someone through shared feelings or experiences.

ex.en: Can you identify the bird sitting on our fence?
ex.zh: 你能认出停在我们围栏上的那只鸟吗？

ex.en: Schools should identify learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support before falling behind.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早发现学习困难，让学生在落后之前获得适当的支持。

tip: identify with某人指产生共鸣，不是辨认对方。

senses.en: who a person is
qualities and beliefs distinguishing a person or group

ex.en: The receptionist checked my identity before handing me the key.
ex.zh: 接待员核实我的身份后，才把钥匙交给我。

ex.en: Preserving local languages can strengthen cultural identity while helping communities pass traditional knowledge to younger generations.
ex.zh: 保护地方语言能够增强文化认同，同时帮助社区向年轻一代传承传统知识。

tip: identity指身份；identify是识别、确认身份的动词。

senses.en: Pay no attention to someone or something

ex.en: Please don't ignore that strange noise from the engine.
ex.zh: 请别忽视发动机发出的那种怪声。

ex.en: Governments cannot ignore the long-term effects of air pollution on children's health and development.
ex.zh: 政府不能忽视空气污染对儿童健康与发育的长期影响。

tip: 直接接宾语；不表示法律上的“驳回诉讼”。
